import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if not path:
    sys.exit(0)
if not path.endswith(('.c', '.h', '.asm', '.S')):
    sys.exit(0)
p = path.replace('\\\\', '/')
# Domain routing table: path pattern -> skill name + summary
routes = [
    ('src/boot/',     'boot-code-quality',     'UEFI error handling, EBS memory ownership, ACPI/SMBIOS table safety, framebuffer guards, boot_info ABI sync, serial-before-klog, POST16 coverage, fallback chains'),
    ('src/desktop/',  'desktop-code-quality',  'WC framebuffer mapping, pitch!=width, back-buffer pattern, pixel format check, non-blocking compositor loop'),
    ('src/shell/',    'shell-code-quality',    'Win32 console API, Windows path conventions, HANDLE-based I/O, syscall error checking'),
    ('user/',         'userland-code-quality', 'user libc linkage, no kernel headers, syscall interface only, Win32 naming, HANDLE I/O'),
    ('src/apps/',     'userland-code-quality', 'user libc linkage, no kernel headers, syscall interface only, Win32 naming, HANDLE I/O'),
    ('src/kernel/',   'kernel-code-quality',   'SMP safety, 5-layer defense, memory rules (kmalloc <= 4 KB), bare-metal correctness, POST16 boot-path only, complete error paths, Gate 10 no TODO/FIXME/HACK'),
    ('include/kernel/', 'kernel-code-quality', 'SMP safety, 5-layer defense, memory rules, bare-metal correctness, POST16 boot-path only, complete error paths, Gate 10'),
]
skill = None
for prefix, name, summary in routes:
    if prefix in p:
        skill = name
        gates = summary
        break
if not skill:
    sys.exit(0)
msg = '[' + skill + ' REQUIRED] About to edit code at ' + path + '. Walk the ' + skill + ' gates BEFORE writing: ' + gates + '.'
print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
"

python3 -c "
import json, sys, subprocess
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
if not cmd.startswith('git commit'):
    sys.exit(0)
try:
    out = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], text=True, timeout=5, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
files = [f.strip() for f in out.split('\n') if f.strip()]
src_exts = ('.c', '.h', '.asm', '.S')
has_src = any(any(f.endswith(e) for e in src_exts) for f in files)
has_todo = any(f.startswith('todo/') and f.endswith('.md') for f in files)
if not (has_src and has_todo):
    sys.exit(0)
msg = ('[section-commit GATE -- implement-todo-section OR verify-todo-section steps 13-18 must have run] '
       'Staged files include source code AND a TODO file. This looks like a section commit from EITHER pipeline (implement or verify -- they share the HARD GATE on steps 13-18). Confirm before proceeding: '
       '13 Codex adversarial review dispatched + findings classified Fix/Reject/Accept; '
       '14 Critical/High fixed (or rejected with code evidence); '
       '15 Self-review walked all checklist items; '
       '16 2nd final build passed; '
       '17 validate-todo-section invoked; '
       '18 loose-end scan complete (verify-mode also runs the deep-analysis pass: codex-consistency-audit, codex-dead-code, codex-perf-review for hot-path, audit-ssdt for SSDT sections). '
       'If any step was skipped, abort the commit and complete the pipeline first. '
       'Pattern to watch for: build passes, looks straightforward, just commit -- '
       'that thought is the signal to STOP.')
print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
"

python3 -c "
import json, sys, subprocess, os
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
resp = str(d.get('tool_response', {}).get('stdout', ''))
if not cmd.startswith('git commit'):
    sys.exit(0)
exts = ('.c', '.h', '.asm', '.ld')
if not any(ext in resp for ext in exts):
    sys.exit(0)
root = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel']).decode().strip()
result = subprocess.run(['bash', root + '/scripts/test.sh', 'QUIET=1'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, env={**os.environ, 'TIMEOUT': '30'})
if result.returncode == 0:
    line = [l for l in result.stdout.splitlines() if 'PASS' in l]
    msg = line[-1].strip() if line else 'Tests passed'
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '[smoketest] ' + msg}))
else:
    fails = [l for l in result.stdout.splitlines() if 'FAIL' in l]
    msg = fails[-1].strip() if fails else 'Tests failed'
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '[smoketest] ' + msg, 'continue': True}))
"
